# National Trial Law

> A Texas-based trial law firm specializing in FTCA claims, military medical malpractice, and personal injury litigation with 50+ years of experience and national reach.

National Trial Law combines deep expertise in Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA) representation with comprehensive personal injury and medical malpractice litigation. The firm serves military personnel, veterans, and civilians with a particular focus on Fort Hood-related cases and federal healthcare claims.

## Key Topics

- Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA)
- Medical Malpractice
- Military Claims
- Personal Injury
- Birth Injury
- Veterans Law
- Trial Lawyers
- Wrongful Death
- Fort Hood
- Contingency Fees
- Texas Law
- FTCA Representation
- Military Medical Negligence
- Federal Litigation
- Product Liability
